issues: The renameCategory implementation fails to follow requirement R6: if rename fails, no receipt categories should be altered. The code updates receipts first, then saves category data, and does not roll back changes on receipt update failures. Also, it does not ensure atomicity or rollback when receipt updates fail, as required.

validateMileageMiles currently validates integer only and does not accept decimal numbers with one decimal place correctly. It uses a regex that disallows strings like "12.5" due to missing anchor handling of optional decimal part, and it returns "Miles can have at most 1 decimal place" incorrectly for valid decimal inputs. This violates R7 and the test expectations for decimal mileage acceptance.

The isCategoryInUse function accepts a Store or name but relies on a global lastUsedStore which may be undefined, causing potential errors when called without a store after a rename. The fallback to getStore() imports './storage' which returns a function getStore, but the implementation may not work in all contexts, potentially violating R5.

The updated categories logic does not mark the renamed category as in use when receipts existed, because isCategoryInUse checks receipts after rename but isCategoryInUse may use a stale store reference; also renameCategory does not update the rename mapping for default categories correctly in all cases (e.g., case‑insensitive old names not matching stored rename mapping). This may cause R1/R2 failures.

BottomActionBar currently does not render the FAB add buttons or Snackbar as required by R10; the FABs are still placed in DashboardScreen, not moved into BottomActionBar. This UI requirement is unmet.
The ReceiptEntryScreen still likely contains duplicate title rendering and date picker icon placement issues (R14, R15) based on unchanged files, which were not inspected but are part of the task.
SettingsScreen likely still contains the old App lock button and outlined buttons for other entries (R18‑R20) as the code was not reviewed for those changes.

The validator for mileage (validateMileageMiles) returns generic error messages not matching the expected wording in the task (e.g., "Miles must be > 0" vs "Miles must be > 0" is okay, but missing specific "Miles can have at most 1 decimal place" wording may be inconsistent). Ensure messages match exactly.

The category rename operation does not enforce uniqueness case‑insensitively when the new name only differs by case from an existing name; the effectiveNames set checks lowercased names but the conditional allowing rename to same name with different case may be flawed, potentially allowing duplicate categories.
The renameCategory function does not wrap receipt updates in a transaction‑like approach; if any receipt update fails, previous updates remain, violating atomicity requirement.
feedback: The code does not meet many of the listed requirements. Critical issues include atomic category renaming with receipt updates, proper decimal mileage validation, UI layout changes (FAB positioning, Snackbar, title duplication, date picker icon, Settings rows), and handling of isCategoryInUse. Please adjust renameCategory to be atomic with proper rollback, update validateMileageMiles to accept one‑decimal numbers, move FABs into BottomActionBar, ensure screens follow the UI specs, and verify all requirements are satisfied before re‑running tests.
